title: spec(migrations): widen the unreleased ADR-0087 entry `packageless-overlay-write-closed` to name the base-named overlay write #28905 also closed
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

Source: the contract review of PR #29270 (#28905), record 6577747588, should-fix S3 (the dev's open question 1, answered A).

`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts` is unreleased and ships in the same release. Its `surface` and `reason` name only the package-less write (#28576). #28905 (merged as `838a802bf3`) closes the same five overlay types to a write that names the read-only base package itself (`?package=<base>`), with the same fix: write into the base's `.custom` pair, declaring `overrides`. The entry's `replacement` already prescribes that TO.

Ask: text only. Widen `surface` and `reason` so that one entry names both closed addresses, and the generated upgrade guide shows both. If the S1 card decides the commit-revert path stays open, add that line too. Lands before the release cut.
